name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is an exploration and royalty-stage gold company focused exclusively on the state of Nevada. The company holds an exploration lease on the Swales Property in the Carlin Trend (Elko County) and a 1% production royalty on the Olinghouse Project in Washoe County. Nevada Canyon operates a low-overhead royalty and leasing business model designed to limit exposure to the operating cost pressures faced by conventional mining companies.
